name: Marine Equipment Template
desc: A field-ready technical package for infantry weapons and equipment. Learn it to make the pattern permanently available in the Fleet Armory.

name: Marine Loadout Card
desc: A complete squad loadout: the weapon issue or tactic sheet together with the equipment it needs. Learn it to make the whole loadout permanently available in the Fleet Armory.

name: Mech Pattern Card
desc: The permanent right to fabricate one mech chassis or weapon component. Learn it to make the pattern available in the Mech Bay.
